newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Chesterfield, N.J..

text.p: The Board of Education of the Township of Chesterfield,
In the County of of Burlington, New Jersey

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the undersigned fo The Board of Education of the Township of Chesterfield, in the County of Burlington, New Jersey (School District'') at the School District's Administrative Office, 295
at which time they be publicly opened and announced for the purchase of the referenced bonds, due on August 1
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
The Bonds will be dated August 1, 1997 and bear interest at the rate per annum specified by the successful bidder therefor, payable on August 1, 1998 and semiannually
thereafter on February 1 and August 1 in each year until maturity. The Bonds will not be subject to redemption prior to maturity.

Upon initial issuance, the Bonds will be issued in book- entry-only form and registered in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''). Individual purchases may be made in the principal amount of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof through book entries made on the books and records of DTC and its participants. The Bonds will be issued subject to the approving legal opinion of Parker, McCay & Criscuolo, Marlton, New Jersey, Bond Counsel to the School District. Copies of the full Notice of Sale and Official Form of Proposal and Preliminary Official Statement may be obtained by contacting Louise Zoikowski, Business Administrator/Board Secretary, at the School District's Administrative Offices, 295 Bordentown-Chesterfield Road, Trenton, New Jersey 08620. The School District's telephone number is (609) 298-6900.
